round-4-record.label: Query Mode (Java SDK transactions)
round-4-record.type: once a transaction executes any SQL++ query statement, that query and every subsequent key-value operation in the same transaction attempt execute under the user's query permissions rather than their data permissions
round-4-record.promotion_reason: promoted below the usual 2-file recurrence bar for semantic significance - one of the two behaviors the round-4 extraction cited as having 'no per-operation analogue at all' in its cross_component_finding, and directly answers a permissions-scope competency question no existing relation covers.
round-4-record.note: A mid-flow permission-scope switch triggered by operation mixing within a single transaction attempt. Query permissions and data permissions may differ, which the source page flags as a source of unexpected results. Object of the minted predicate triggersPermissionModeChange, itself still extraction-layer only (recurrence 1) - watchlisted alongside this concept, see reconciliation.md round 4.
